name: Jitendra Singh Parihar
title: Founder & CEO of Medixa Global LLP
description: Jitendra Singh Parihar is the founder and CEO of Medixa Global LLP, a leader in healthcare innovation known for its advanced digital health solutions. Jitendra, a gold medalist from IIT BHU, has spearheaded numerous transformative initiatives that have elevated patient care and streamlined healthcare operations. He has been featured on esteemed platforms like Forbes India, The Economic Times, and YourStory, where his contributions to the healthcare industry have been widely recognized. As the co-host of STARTUPSANGAM 2024, Jitendra brings his extensive knowledge and visionary leadership to inspire and guide aspiring entrepreneurs and industry professionals.

name: Arvind Dixit
title: Founder of Advance Tech
description: Arvind Dixit founded Advance Tech, a leader in technological innovation and product development. With a strong background in engineering, he has driven the company's success in delivering cutting-edge solutions across various industries. Recognized for his expertise, Arvind is a frequent speaker on platforms like TechCrunch and Business Today, where he shares insights on emerging technologies and entrepreneurship.

name: Rupesh Kumar
title: Researcher at Yamaha Motor India
description: Rupesh Kumar is an accomplished researcher at Yamaha Motor India, specializing in R&D with a focus on computer vision, video processing, and image processing. A graduate of IIT Kanpur, Rupesh brings expertise in conventional and advanced methods, including deep learning and machine learning, to tackle complex problems.

name: Surojit Bose
title: Partner at Climate9ers Capital
description: Surojit Bose is a venture capitalist and Partner at Climate9ers Capital, a SEBI-registered angel fund. He also serves as an Independent Director on the board of Shivalic Power Control Ltd. As a co-founder of LeadInvent Pharma Inc., he has been instrumental in developing innovative pharmaceutical solutions, including GBGel for residual brain tumors. His work centers on fostering innovation and nurturing the entrepreneurial ecosystem.

name: Anupam Anand
title: CEO & Co-Founder of Deltron Technologies Pvt Ltd
description: Anupam Anand is the CEO and Co-Founder of Deltron Technologies Pvt Ltd, specializing in IT services, solutions, and digital marketing. He also serves as a Managing Partner at Inceptra Solutions LLC in the USA, focusing on staff augmentation and talent placement. As the President of the Whiteboard Education and Research Foundation, Anupam is dedicated to bridging the gap between academia and industry. An experienced career coach and startup mentor, he has guided over 25,000 students and is recognized as one of Tradeflock's '40 Under 40' business leaders in India. Anupam is also the host of 'The Changemaker Show' on YouTube, where he shares insights from industry experts.

name: Lalit Ambastha
title: Founder of Patentwire and co-founder of IPBazzaar
description: Lalit Ambastha is an esteemed IP Attorney and Strategist with over 18 years of experience in Intellectual Property. He is the founder of Patentwire and a co-founder of IPBazzaar, NewtonsLaw, InkPat, and Palani LLC. Lalit also serves as a founding member at RIPA and an ESG Advisor at IASE. He is recognized for his expertise in IP prosecution, licensing, valuation, and technology transfer, working with clients such as DMRC, GMR, Honda, and Novartis. Lalit has held guest faculty positions at prestigious institutions and contributes to IP awareness programs with the Ministry of MSME, Govt. of India.

name: Imran Yusuf
title: Project Manager for the Department of Biotechnology(DBT)
description: Imran Yusuf is a Project Manager for the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) Human Resource Development (HRD) PMU PAN India Capacity Building initiative. He previously led IoT, Electrical, Electronics, and Manufacturing at SIIC IIT-Kanpur and served as an Assistant Professor in Electronics and Communication Engineering. With a strong background in project management and academia, Imran Yusuf is dedicated to advancing capacity building and technological innovation.

name: Alok Tiwari
title: CEO of AIVOT AI
description: Alok Tiwari is the Founder and CEO of AIVOT AI, specializing in advanced artificial intelligence solutions across diverse industries. With over 21 years of experience in business management, strategic consulting, and investment advisory, Alok holds an MBA from Tippie School of Business, University of Iowa, an Advanced Program in FinTech and Blockchain from IIM Calcutta, and a Master’s degree in Quantum Finance from IIT Kanpur. He is recognized for his work in AI and blockchain, including the development of an AI-based measurement solution, and has managed various businesses and investment strategies.

name: Prof. J. Ram Kumar
title: Dean of Infrastructure & Planning, IIT Kanpur
description: Prof. J. Ram Kumar is a distinguished academic in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at IIT Kanpur, where he serves as Dean of Infrastructure & Planning. With a PhD from IIT Madras, he specializes in micro/nanomanufacturing, tribology, and manufacturing process modeling. He holds prestigious positions as a Fellow of INAE and Satish Chandra Agarwal Chair Professor at IIT Kanpur. His numerous awards include the Eminent Production Engineer Award and the IETE-Shri Devi Singh Memorial Award. Prof. Kumar is also noted for his leadership in the Imagineering Lab and RuTAG at IIT Kanpur.

name: Prof. Rajiv Kumar Kapoor
title: Faculty Member, Department of ECE, DTU
description: Prof. Rajiv Kumar Kapoor is a distinguished academic in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Delhi Technological University (DTU), where he has been a faculty member since November 2009. He also served as the Principal of the Ambedkar Institute of Advanced Communication Technologies and Research (AIACTR). Prof. Kapoor holds a BE, ME, and PhD in Electronics and Communication Engineering. His research interests span Vision/Speech-based Tracking, Machine Learning, Activity Recognition, Signal Processing, Pattern Recognition, Cognitive Radio, and Biomedical Equipment Design.
